block.label: REMEMBER · ONE PAST FORM ONLY
block.html:
Legend: watched = the past form (the same for everyone) · didn't / Did = the auxiliary for negatives and questions.

With didn't and Did, the verb goes back to the base form:
I watched a movie. → I didn't watch a movie. → Did you watch a movie?
She went to work. → She didn't go to work. → Did she go to work?

✗ I didn't went. ✗ Did you watched? → ✓ I didn't go. ✓ Did you watch?

models.title: Past Simple × Past Continuous · when and while

block.label: QUICK REVIEW · WHEN × WHILE
block.html:
Past Continuous = the long action, in progress (the background).
Past Simple = the short action, complete (it interrupts).

I was watching TV when the phone rang.
She was watching TV when the lights went out.

While + long action: While I was watching TV, the phone rang.
When + short action: I was watching TV when the phone rang.

Two long actions at the same time → while + while:
While I was watching TV, my brother was cooking.

One action after the other → only Past Simple:
When I arrived, I watched TV. (first I arrived, then I watched)

models.title: Reading · the night of the power cut

block.label: READING · THE NIGHT OF THE POWER CUT
block.html:
Last Tuesday, at 8:15 p.m., all the lights in our building went out.

At that moment, everybody was doing something different. I was taking a shower, and the water was still hot, so I didn't stop. My wife was cooking pasta. She couldn't see anything, so she turned off the stove and looked for a candle.

In the apartment next door, Mr. Souza was watching a football game. He was so angry! He ran to the window and shouted: "Not now! There are five minutes left!" Upstairs, two teenagers were playing video games. When the screen went black, they didn't know what to do, so they went to the balcony and started talking to the neighbors.

While everybody was complaining, Dona Lúcia, the old lady on the first floor, was sitting on her sofa, calm and happy. Why? She was listening to the game on her old radio, with batteries! When the lights came back at 9:00, half the building was in her living room, and Brazil was winning 2 to 1.
